scope: Traditional text form only. Current canonical implementation and locked SourceLoginDialog/ViewModel; mutable callback work-in-progress files were not read.

confirmedProductionGap.summary: Traditional original form has no dirty working-map persistence on non-OK dismissal.
canonicalLocations: BookSourceFormLoginView.swift:60 onValueChange only persists legacy select; original select/toggle changes stay in values
BookSourceFormLoginView.swift:171 onDisappear invalidates generations and cancels three tasks without saving
OriginalLoginUIRuntime.kt:43-50 fills empty select/toggle working values without a persistent write
lockedLocations: SourceLoginDialog.kt:463/478/581/616/637 marks original select/toggle defaults and real changes dirty
SourceLoginDialog.kt:868-875 non-V2 dismissal writes/removes working loginInfo iff !oKToClose && hasChange
confirmedProductionGap.concreteExample: A valid original loginUi has a select with no saved value. The locked builder inserts its default and sets hasChange; close persists that map. iOS renders the same default into transient values, then close/onDisappear cancels tasks and writes nothing. The same loss applies to a user select/toggle edit without successful OK.
confirmedProductionGap.notClaimed: This does not imply text-only edits should autosave, or that unsupported callback delivery currently works.

minimalActualConnectionConstraints.location: Same BookSourceFormLoginView @State plus current grid callbacks
minimalActualConnectionConstraints.requirement: Keep the workingMap distinct from the displayed text/password edit map. Do not implement dismissal by passing currentFormValues/originalFormSubmissionValues/current values to a writer: that would persist text edits the locked dismiss path intentionally excludes, and currentFormValues also drops hidden keys.

minimalActualConnectionConstraints.location: Existing typed loginUi render DTO and mapper
minimalActualConnectionConstraints.requirement: Carry enough actual metadata to distinguish initial/default working-map changes and a dynamic re-render from an ordinary text field edit. LegadoOriginalLoginUIResult already exposes dynamic, but LegadoOriginalLoginUIForm currently drops it. A byte-difference heuristic alone cannot detect the locked empty-default dirty branch. Do not infer persistence authority from a receipt.

After the current valid-form/not-loading guards accept original OK, set the close-suppression flag before any await/Task launch/credential write. Failure or cancellation must not reset that sticky fact for the same dialog lifetime. A failed initial render must not set the flag or clear credentials.

minimalActualConnectionConstraints.location: Actual close button, successful OK close and real sheet dismissal path
minimalActualConnectionConstraints.requirement: One lifetime/generation owns close work. Repeated onDisappear must neither issue duplicate writes nor reset/ACK a newer dirty map. Drain or invalidate current action/render/submission according to their existing effects semantics before freezing the close snapshot. Do not start an unowned asynchronous save and immediately lose all pending state as the view disappears; if UIKit dismissal has already completed a later write failure cannot honestly be presented as saved.

minimalActualConnectionConstraints.location: Same LoginManager checked owner via existing source/transport validation
minimalActualConnectionConstraints.requirement: Use off-main checked credential owner mutation with its actual Bool/error, same revision notification and sourceURL; empty workingMap must remove info rather than encode {} or return early. Existing void storeLoginInfo logs a rejected save and cannot report success to a close flow; legacy persistCurrentFormValues drops empty/hidden keys and is unsuitable. Do not call formLogin or loginAction merely to save on dismiss because those evaluate source loginJS.

minimalActualConnectionConstraints.location: Source validity and persistence failure handling
minimalActualConnectionConstraints.requirement: Revalidate actual source identity/revision/removal at the existing source-authority boundary before issuing a write, rather than trusting the View captured source value. A rejected/throwing write must not clear dirty state or report saved. A cancellation after a checked owner commit must retain its actual effect and must not be retried as though no write occurred.

implementationBoundary: These are source-backed constraints for a later minimal production connection in the same View/LoginManager/source owner. No alternate store, VM, JSC route, broad plan or helper-only patch is proposed. The mutable callback transport and its eventual frozen definitions remain a separate pending independent review.
findingsNotEstablished: No new SDK compilation error is inferred from this audit.
Whether a particular UIKit interactive dismissal/cover path emits onDisappear once or repeatedly is device/runtime behavior and is not claimed tested.
Original loginUi v2/deltaUp true and browser/WebJS are outside this slice.
